blocks.orig: The Karatu Tented Lodge lies at a 15-minute drive from the town of Karatu, on a hill overlooking the Lake Manyara plains and the Ngorongoro Highlands. It has ten spacious safari tents with thatched roofs, decorated in a combination of dark wood, light colours and African tones. The tents boast fluffy beds, free Wi-Fi, an ensuite bathroom and a private terrace with chairs and a table. There is a central restaurant with a fireplace for colder evenings, and large gardens offer a swimming pool and an outdoor barbecue for warmer nights.
blocks.html: Fifteen minutes’ drive from Karatu town, The Karatu Tented Lodge sits on a hill with views across the Lake Manyara plains and the Ngorongoro Highlands. There are ten roomy safari tents with thatched roofs, furnished in a mix of dark wood, light colours and African tones. Each tent has soft beds, free Wi-Fi, an en-suite bathroom and a private terrace with a table and chairs. A central restaurant with a fireplace keeps you warm on cooler evenings, while the large gardens have a swimming pool and an outdoor barbecue for warmer nights.
